title: 第四十一章 带火移星陆升云出鼎湖第四十章 看我法器化险为夷
lines: 第四十一章带火移星陆，升云出鼎湖！
昏暗宙宇，十二道恒星之光铺天盖地，照彻寰空，按照既定的轨道徐徐行进，仿佛永远都不会熄灭。
然而就在尤雪心被王平斩杀的同时。
其中一道恒星之光，陡然生出了些许波动，犹如石子落入湖面，激起些微涟漪，没入恒星之光深处。
入目所见，是一座恢弘州陆。
其四面环海，山脉高耸，河川林立，各种名胜古迹数不胜数，一道道遁光来往，俨然一处仙家圣地。
可也就是这时，位于大陆的西北角，青天白日之下，竟有霹雳声响，不见云雨，唯有雷霆之音滚空而过，而且海愈演愈烈，惊动地上走兽奔腾，天中鸟兽齐飞，凡人叩首跪拜，修士茫然四顾。
“怎么回事？”
年轻修士面面相觑，不知发生了什么。
唯有一些资历深的修士见状露出了感慨之色：
“天发雷音，却不见缘由，恐怕是有炼炁士被惊动，心生怒念，天地迎合其意，这才有此晴空霹雳。”
“看这雷音源头....是日月湖？”
交谈间，年轻修士一拍手：
“我想起来了，日月湖的明幽师叔大限将至，恐怕是打坐时有感时日无多，所以才突然生出了怒意....”
“嘘！慎言！”
话音未落，说话的年轻修士就被旁边的师兄猛然捂住了嘴巴，用力之大，差点将他的嘴巴直接撕烂。
“你不要命了！？”
捂嘴师兄怒道：“明幽师叔当年炼的可是【洞见真妄开明炁】，随便乱说，他一个念头就能看到你的！”
年轻修士闻言也面露惧色：“有，有这么厉害？”
“废话，你是哪位师叔门下，这都不知道？”
“呃，尚未拜师，还是内门弟子.....”
“哦，内门啊，那就不奇怪了。”
话音未落，就见捂嘴师兄嫌弃地后退了一步，用法力洗了洗刚刚用来捂嘴的手，随后直接转身离去。
只留下年轻修士在风中凌乱。
类似的乱象也在州陆的其他地方出现，不少人都纷纷抬起头，遥遥看向了作为晴空霹雳源头的地方。
【日月湖】。
虽然名为湖泊，但实际规模却极为庞大，乃是一座陆中海，湖水分黑白二色，宛若一副古典水墨画。
而在黑白湖水的中央，两仪划分之地，则是立着一座小岛，岛上结了一座草庐，此刻正有人从庐中走出，一身黑白袍服，头戴鱼尾冠，手里持着一柄拂尘，虽身着正装，却是一副少年人模样。
他站在那里，抬头望天。
只见以草庐为中心，万里方圆之内有雷蛇盘绕，霹雳滚空，还有绚烂霞光荡漾，引得水天共映一色。
少年就这样直勾勾看着天中彩霞，眼底眸光好似灯火辉煌，明暗瞬间，随后低下头，徐徐叹了一声：
“雪心死了。”
声音和少年模样截然相反，苍老，垂暮气十足。
“死在了押送【五贼盗天万化神符】的路上，刻意将此物送来，也算有孝心，不过终究是擅离职守。”
彩霞微微波动，颜色变换。
content_en:
Chapter 41: Bring fire to the stars and land, rise into the clouds and leave Ding Lake!
In the dim universe, the light of twelve stars is overwhelming, illuminating the sky, moving slowly according to the established orbit, as if it will never go out.
However, at the same time that You Xuexin was beheaded by Wang Ping.
One of the stars' light suddenly produced some fluctuations, like a stone falling into a lake, causing some ripples and sinking into the depths of the star's light.
What you can see is a magnificent state.
It is surrounded by the sea on all sides, with towering mountains, numerous rivers, and numerous places of interest and historic sites. The light comes and goes, making it look like a holy land of immortals.
But at this time, in the northwest corner of the mainland, under the blue sky and white sun, there was the sound of thunder. There was no cloud or rain, only the sound of thunder rolling through the air. The sea became more and more intense, causing animals on the ground to gallop, birds and beasts in the sky to fly together, mortals kowtowed, and monks looked around blankly.
"What's going on?"
The young monks looked at each other, wondering what had happened.
Only some senior monks showed emotion when they saw this:
"There is thunder in the sky, but there is no reason. I am afraid that some Qi refiners were alarmed and had angry thoughts in their hearts. The heaven and earth catered to their wishes, and this is why there was this thunderbolt in the clear sky."
"Look at the source of the thunder... is it Sun Moon Lake?"
During the conversation, the young monk clapped his hands:
"I remembered that Uncle Mingyou of Riyue Lake is approaching his end. I am afraid that he felt that time was running out while meditating, so he suddenly became angry..."
"Hush! Be careful!"
Before he finished speaking, the young monk who was speaking was suddenly covered by his mouth by the senior brother next to him. The force was so strong that his mouth was almost torn to pieces.
"You don't want your life!?"
Senior Brother Covered His Mouth said angrily: "Senior Uncle Mingyou was practicing [Insight into True False Enlightenment and Ming Qi] back then. If you say anything you want, he can see you with just one thought!"
The young monk also showed fear when he heard this: "Yes, is it so powerful?"
"Nonsense, you don't even know which master's disciple you are?"
"Well, I haven't become a disciple yet, but I'm still an inner disciple..."
"Oh, the inner door, that's not surprising."
Before he finished speaking, Brother Covering his mouth took a step back in disgust, used magic power to wash the hand he had just used to cover his mouth, and then turned around and left.
Only the young monk was left messy in the wind.
Similar chaos also occurred in other places in Zhoulu. Many people raised their heads and looked at the source of the thunderbolt from a distance.
【Sun Moon Lake】.
Although it is called a lake, its actual size is extremely large. It is a sea within a land. The water in the lake is black and white, just like a classical ink painting.
In the middle of the black and white lake, where the two bodies are separated, there is a small island with a thatched cottage on it. At this moment, someone is walking out of the cottage. He is wearing a black and white robe, a fishtail crown on his head, and holding a whisk in his hand. Although he is dressed in formal clothes, he looks like a young man.
He stood there, looking up at the sky.
I saw that with the thatched cottage as the center, within a radius of thousands of miles, there were thunder snakes coiling, thunderbolts rolling in the sky, and brilliant rays of light rippling, making the water and sky reflect the same color.
The young man just looked straight at the colorful clouds in the sky, his eyes were like bright lights, and there was an instant of light and dark. Then he lowered his head and sighed slowly:
"Snowheart is dead."
His voice was completely opposite to his youthful appearance. He was old and full of twilight.
"He died on the way to escort the [Five Thieves Stealing Heavenly Myriad Transformation Talisman]. Deliberately sending this thing here can be regarded as filial piety, but after all, it is AWOL."
The colorful clouds fluctuate slightly and change colors.
title_en: Chapter 41: Bringing fire and moving stars, Lu Shengyun comes out of Ding Lake Chapter 40: Watch my magic weapon save the day
